features.note: Both rack ears read under the front-favoring rig; the top face is dimmer (correctly, no features there) but still catches the environment. No regression.
Display reads crisply (PANDUIT + INPUT/OUTPUT/BATTERY bars) under the grazing key; the lowered key rakes the panel instead of washing the top. Dominant panel element, well-lit.
Button and the 4 green LEDs read clearly on the lit front. No regression.

Front grille reads via the stamped lip under the raised front fill; the side-vent grid stays legible in the shadowed flank because the left fill was lifted 0.28->0.34 to keep its slots. The builder correctly reasoned the front fill is SAFE to raise here (unlike the Stratix): these recesses are 2.5 mm and read from the louvre blade + bright lip (329x), not from starving the face, where the switch's 4.5 mm jack throats would have flattened under a strong front.

important_features.note: Deep body reads; the shadowed flank (front/side contrast preserved) carries the depth. No regression.

defects: OPEN ITEM (not a defect): rear receptacle layout still unbuilt.
corrections: Keep rear receptacles as an OPEN ITEM.

mechanical.notes: Console clean (0/0) on default and power=off. Framing default fullyVisible/wellFramed/no-HUD. Re-aimed rig (analytic irradiance per normal): FRONT +z 1.801->1.999 (all 4 criticals live here), TOP +y 1.328->1.079 (-19%, the largest face and feature-less), front/top 1.36->1.85, flank separation 2.27 preserved. Levers: key y 2.0->1.4 (graze not wash), top fill 0.40->0.22, front fill 0.72->0.85, left fill 0.28->0.34 (keep the shadowed flank's slots). Five criteria asserted against silent detune. Two builder self-catches: (1) he had measured a rig that DID NOT EXIST — a hand-transcribed test file put the key at (3.0,2.5,4.0) where the code has (2.5,2.0,3.0); fixed at the root by extracting the rig to a pure factory the check IMPORTS (a transcription cannot drift from a module it does not contain — same fix that made the Stratix rig measurable); (2) an orphaned duplicate `const lights = {...}` left after cutting the old lamp block, caught by the syntax check on the real file.

notes: Inline orchestrator judgment. Third asset running where the inherited rig carried another subject's answer, and the third correct-DIFFERENT answer: the PDU (vertical bar) needed the key LOWERED, the Stratix (top-face critical) needed it RAISED, and this horizontal chassis has its largest face (the 440x666 top) feature-less with all four criticals on the front — so light is pulled OFF the top and ONTO the front. All criticals read on a well-lit front, the top is appropriately dim, the flank vents survive. The measurement-not-transcription discipline (rig factory the check imports) is the same hardening that made the Stratix rig trustworthy. Cleared to the interaction-ui pass.
